senses.definition: To try to get a ride in a passing vehicle while standing at the side of a road, generally by either sticking out one's finger or thumb or holding a sign with one's stated destination.
senses.example: She made a great many photographs, and hitchhiked her way back to Lanchow again, and thence to Peking.

senses.definition: To try to get (a ride) in this manner.
senses.example: Pamela hitchhiked a ride to New York.

senses.definition: To be carried along with something else.
senses.example: In genetic hitchhiking, a gene is propagated because it occurs in conjunction with a favourable mutation.

senses.definition: Alternative form of hitchhiker (“advertisement at the end of a programme”).
senses.example: There are just too many diseases for each to have its own special organization, complete with radio hitchhikes, sponsored ads, expensive brochures, pledge cards, team captains and collection envelopes.
